topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: The boundary shifts, a line of posts and wire slicing through the familiar whispers of wind and rustle. I scent the air, familiar yet tinged with change. This new obstruction, it narrows paths, alters the dance of the forest. Yet, in the eyes of the one who walks beside me, a quiet understanding. We share this space, a closeness in the towering pines and the soft moss underfoot. Our paths cross here, even as the earth is marked. I linger, not in defiance, but in a gentle pause, a moment to weave my presence into the fabric of what remains. The forest breathes, and in its rhythm, we find a way forward, together.
